latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of chain-audit-deploy-skill.

- Audits and deploys Solidity, Sui Move, and Solana smart contracts.
- Enforces an audit-first workflow for contract security, with detailed pass/fail logic.
- Provides automated and AI-driven audit reports including business logic checks.
- Step-by-step deployment guidance with strong mainnet safety and parameter checks.
- Includes built-in example projects for each supported chain with clear audit/deploy instructions.
- Clearly separates out-of-scope uses and enforces strict safety rules around key handling and network selection.
